tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0018 1. Proposition 1.10\group model-geometries

Let $(\M ^n,g)$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold.

  1. $\Isom (\M ^n,g)$ is a Lie group and acts smoothly on $\M ^n$.

  2. For each $x \in \M ^n$, the isotropy group $I_x(\M ^n,g)$ is a compact subgroup of $\Isom (\M ^n,g)$.

  3. For each $x \in \M ^n$, the linear isotropy representation $\lambda _x : I_x(\M ^n,g) \to \Ogroup (T_x \M ^n, g(x))$ is an injective group homomorphism onto a closed subgroup of the orthogonal group. In particular, $I_x(\M ^n,g)$ is compact.
